documents.title: Payments processing market outlook 2025-2030
documents.text: Card acceptance kept widening last year. The global payments processing market is projected to grow at a compound annual rate of 9.8% from 2025 to 2030. Growth is strongest among small merchants.

documents.title: Merchant acquiring: volumes and margins in 2025
documents.text: Merchant acquiring revenue grew 7.4% in 2025, according to the survey. Margins held steady.

documents.title: Payments sector growth hits a record in 2025
documents.text: Payments volumes climbed again in 2025 as card acceptance spread among small merchants.
